# DG Scales

> Facebook & Instagram ads agency helping businesses scale revenue with high-performing paid social campaigns, weekly reporting, and founder-led account management.

DG Scales runs Meta ad campaigns for construction, hardscaping, landscaping, home improvement, e-commerce, and high-ticket service businesses. Services include creative production, audience testing, daily optimization, and transparent KPI reporting.
